definitions: An exaggerated expression of praise or flattery.
The form of an adjective or adverb that expresses the highest degree of the quality or attribute denoted by the adjective or adverb (e.g., 'best', 'strongest', 'fastest').
examples: He spoke in superlatives about her performance.
The grammar lesson covered the use of superlatives.
Critics used every superlative imaginable to describe the film.
